title: Score reloaded bundles on FINAL 1,000 + 1,000 twins (cap 8,000 Jev)
description:
## Purpose

Score the frozen round-3 bundles on FINAL (1,000 test items + 1,000 twins) through reloaded bundles.

## Scope

Arms 0, A-c, F, F-rand, A-c+F; no rounds run; arm 0 from cached J0 answers if the dry run confirms the cache matches, otherwise F-rand runs on the 1,000 originals only to stay within the cap.

## Cost cap

Hard cap 8,000 Jev requests (about $3.2-4.8); cumulative ledger at most 15,000.

## Definition of done

Final summary (text-free) with accuracy, Brier, ECE, twin metrics and paired intervals next to the free and published rows; actual spend.
